data.body:
[P2] Preserve ordinary JSON that resembles a serializer envelope

This decoder runs for every operation override, but invoke results use `DEFAULT_JSON_SERDES` by default, and steps can explicitly use `JsonSerDes`. A valid result such as `{"t":"m","v":{}}` is therefore changed to `{}`. Transforms expecting the original object can then fail and silently omit the result. Gate decoding on known serializer provenance or make decoding an explicit override option; preserve JSON/pass-through results and add a regression covering this collision.
